narrative.title: Checking the Manifest One Car at a Time
narrative.scenario: A yard clerk must confirm whether a shipment code rides anywhere on a one-way chained train. There is no index to jump to — the only option is to step through each car and compare its label with the code, answering yes the moment one matches and no when the chain runs out.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer n, an array arr of n node values, and an integer key.
narrative.outputFormat: true when key appears in the list, false otherwise.

testCases.explanation: The walk reaches the third car and finds 3.
The chain ends without a single match, so the answer is false.

hintLevels: Level 1: No shortcuts exist on a one-way chain — every car must be checked until the code appears.
Level 2: Walk from the head, compare each node's data with the key, and return true on the first hit.
Level 3: Falling off the end of the loop without a match is the false path; duplicates cost nothing extra because the first hit exits.
